captions.instagram:
Concept. Not a client project. Halfmoon Bend is a fictional motel.

It’s 7pm on a road trip and you want a bed tonight. This motel’s homepage won’t say if there’s a room. You type your dates into a booking form, it sends you to a different website, and the dates are gone. Nothing says what happens if you arrive late.

So we put “Rooms free tonight” on the photo, filled in tonight’s dates, kept the booking on the same site and explained late check-in in one line.

Can a tired driver book your place in a minute? Free review at prycedigital.com/book
